name: Clearpath Jackal (ROS2)
author: Henosync Team — Monash University
description: Clearpath Jackal UGV via rosbridge — ROS2 Clearpath stack. VICON or GPS positioning. Nav2 goal_pose movement, plus manual teleop.

host.label: Rosbridge IP Address
host.description: IP of the Jackal's onboard computer running rosbridge_server.

namespace.label: ROS2 Namespace
namespace.description: Clearpath's ROS2 stack derives this from the robot serial by default (e.g. serial cpr-a200-0001 -> a200_0001). Leave blank if unnamespaced.

position_source.label: Positioning Source
position_source.description: VICON: position from motion capture (lab use). GPS: onboard GPS receiver (outdoor use).

vicon_object_name.label: VICON Object Name
vicon_object_name.description: VICON mode only — must exactly match the object name in the VICON software.

home_lat.label: Home Latitude
home_lat.description: VICON mode only — WGS84 latitude of the VICON arena origin (X=0, Y=0). Also assumed to be the origin of the Jackal's Nav2 map frame — verify this alignment before trusting Move To.

home_lon.label: Home Longitude
home_lon.description: VICON mode only — WGS84 longitude of the VICON arena origin (X=0, Y=0).

gps_topic.label: GPS Topic Override
gps_topic.description: GPS mode only. Default guess follows Clearpath's sensor naming convention — the exact topic depends on which GPS unit is attached. Verify with `ros2 topic list` on the robot.

camera_topic.label: Camera Topic Override
camera_topic.description: Only used if Camera capability is selected below. Jackal is a modular platform — verify the actual topic with `ros2 topic list` since it depends on which camera is attached. Also requires web_video_server running on the robot.

lidar_topic.label: LIDAR Topic Override
lidar_topic.description: Only used if LIDAR capability is selected below. Verify the actual topic with `ros2 topic list` since it depends on which lidar is attached (2D sensor_msgs/LaserScan assumed).

max_linear_speed.label: Max Linear Speed (m/s)
max_linear_speed.description: Used for manual teleop driving (arrow keys) — tune to this robot's actual safe operating limit.

max_angular_speed.label: Max Angular Speed (rad/s)
max_angular_speed.description: Used for manual teleop driving (arrow keys) — tune to this robot's actual safe operating limit.
